marco: Heads-up: updated the Shared Parental Leave section in the handbook and rolling out a 12-minute compliance + attestation for managers. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/shared-parental-leave 

marco: Managers need to confirm coverage plans for any team member on leave via the tracker. It's a quick checkbox + 2 Qs. Due in two weeks.

olivia: Thanks. Does this apply to managers in EMEA/APAC too? We have region-specific rules.

marco: Yes. Regional notes are included on the page. Where local law is more generous, local law prevails (clarified in the update).

nora: For the tracker CSV, can we get columns: employee_email, manager_email, region, attestation, completed_at? Need it for headcount modeling.

marco: Yep — that exact column set will be in the export. We'll also add an "extension_requested" column.

tim: Contractors question: long-term aos/consultants with Redwood accounts — are they included?

marco: If they have company accounts, they get the assignment. Short-term temps without accounts are excluded unless a manager requests a temporary training account.

people-ops-bot: Automated assignment: 164 people assigned to "Shared Parental Leave  manager attestation". Due: 2025-11-03. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-10-20 08:45 UTC) :bell:

olivia: Missed deadline process?

marco: Reminder emails at 7 and 2 days left. >14 days late = manager follow-up and a flag in the HR dashboard. No formal penalty on first miss.

nora: Will send a note to managers once the CSV is published. Thanks!
